{{Top|leg}}
A '''tarpaulin''' was a large sheet of material. It was draped over a piece of equipment, such as a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], to protect it from the elements. One could also be hung over an open doorway to serve as a makeshift curtain.

{{Substance-stub}}
